changelog.change: v4: physical-relay variant r25gqn_pr, hgi_idx w8 slot, spine moved, views wrappers
D1 hfd_hc: 2,032.944 x 1,499.04 -> 2,032.944 x 1,684.8 (equator edge fixed, grows away from the equator); N tr row-1 att->SU relays move up 185.76 um with it [decided v1]
D2 hfd_hc: v1.1: no quarter cluster / no M8-PG quarter; the 88 closed tiles (PG M7) are placed by the die in an HC region, die straps M8 (supersedes v1 "tile_xl PG M6") [decided v1.1]
D4 hfd_attn_half_lo/hi: v10 lo 1,778.52 x 1,263.6 / hi 689.04 (c07156bbc) [in place]

D5 hfd_hgi_vm: v3: VM tunit builds at the die config (main 20730548c) + ot_hgi_vm_btile.sv; latency contract request->response +12, rq->rr +8, rq->credit +6, w2q->credit +6 / ->done +8, wq->done +8, ap RTT +2, reset +3 (vm_tunit record); TUNIT stays 0 until the btile + VM parent close [contract v3]
D6 hfd_sfu/su ctl: DENR=1 now; SFUT=2 when the lane cluster closes [open]

D7 hfd_hc: v3: 88 tile sub-slots per quarter from macro_place.tcl @87e02e7ad (8 x 11 serpentine, all inside 2,032.944 x 1,684.8; top 201 um band for head relays); region gate waits on tile child_lint (f) [contract v3]
D8 hfd_vm_sw/se/nw/ne: v3: 36 VM8 tile sub-slots (6 open halves x 6, 9adc3c44e); e half at x 349.056; clock entry ckt<k> M7 area pin; +1 cycle on the listed half seams [contract v3]
D9 hfd_sfu: v3: 16 lane-cluster sub-slots 159.84 x 330.48 per quarter on the old lane lattice (173-um channels = face/broadcast relay stages); ctlw tile moves to hfd_su [contract v3]
D10 hfd_hgi_idx: w8 cluster slot growth (rf2) + IXW=1 lane-station request (idxs 20:45): accepted in principle -- lgE KE 4 -> 5 once the IXW adapter passes its bench [open]
D11 hfd_idx_score_native_grid: v3: two-level, 32 r2 hslice sub-slots per grid (no chunk cluster) [contract v3]
D12 NO3 station: v3: not a R25GQ element (R24W W2 publication chain); recorded only [decided v3]

D13 die: v4: contract on r25gqn_pr (b4638437b): data segments > 504 um 985 -> 0, 0 overlaps, die 856.95 mm2 (svc channels +108 um); residual check rc 3 = 8 clock/reset tree segments > 504 um + 7 far-side data relays, all at the lk_ep S row (84-um gaps full) -> D16 [v4 (residual open)]

D14 hfd_cmdproc / hfd_coll: coll_recx 554 b (TOPK_MERGE sideband): t_hgi_coll widens by 554 b when the TKM tiles compose on the die (die coll view TKM=0 today); lgEcp / lgEatt / t_hgi_e2* classed OPEN with owners (main 04dad4b3a) [open]

D15 hfd_hgi_idx: v4: 640.008 x 600.48 -> 1,270.08 x 1,719.36 at (14,800.32, 7,112.88) for the w8 cluster (43.2 um to idx_selector); spine above moves up: idx_selector y 8,875, coll 10,902, hgi_vm 12,506, cmdproc 14,623 [v4]
D16 hfd_lk_ep S row: re-grant pending: the 84-um inter-ep channels carry every N-S crossing of the row; widen to >= 200 um (pitch 2,800) or move the S row [open]
D17 hfd_hc_eng: lane-major N-face re-pin accepted; needs per-lane ports in the die bus model (generator places each port contiguous) and the lgE station spanning the full 4,384.8 face [open]
